implementation.writer: The typed primitive collector accepts exactly one class family per selected profile: BOX or TORUS. TORUS requires complete EvalExpr/HistoryNode/action prefixes, one node with no edges, node value 0, two positive finite radii, a null material link, spec-conforming CMC or caller-supplied indexed color, and unique reciprocal handles. Mixed/other class families remain refused.
implementation.dxfReplay: The same-profile raw DXF closure recognizes the 34-group TORUS record and permits group 347 = 0 only for TORUS; BOX material validation remains unchanged.
